language.name: English
app.description: A presentation editor on reveal.js, usable by people who do not want to write Markdown — and it still stores nothing but Markdown.
app.short: A presentation editor on reveal.js that stores nothing but Markdown.
prefs.title: Settings
prefs.autosaveNote: Off: nothing is written until you press the button in the header. Paging through the slides and starting the talk work unsaved all the same — with everything you have typed.
prefs.note: Applies to this browser, not to the deck.
prefs.presenterNote: These keys toggle the fullscreen while presenting. For paging, reveal.js listens for Page Down and Page Up by itself -- nothing is needed here for that.
prefs.startNote: In the editor this key opens the talk from the first slide, in a tab of its own. With no key it does nothing.
prefs.recording: Press the key on the presenter now ... (Escape cancels)
prefs.reserved: {key} pages the presentation and stays that way
prefs.none: No key -- the button stays without effect.
overview.empty: No talk yet. The box below creates the first one.
dialog.leaveText: What you have written is not in the file yet. Leaving now would lose it.
source.head: Header
source.failed: The source could not be fetched.
dialog.codeStyleDefault: Like the rest of the talk
dialog.codeNote: The block goes to the end of the slide, where a click opens it again.
dialog.title: Title
dialog.note: The title goes on the first slide and can be changed at any time.
column.splitHint: Drag to move the boundary, double-click puts it back.
editor.layoutLocked: The layout stays while there is text on the slide -- switching would lose some of it too easily.
editor.heading: Heading
editor.columnsSplitHint: Every column gets a text of its own; the buttons above the field choose which. Off, the text stays one and flows through the columns.
editor.textPlaceholder: Write the text of the slide here.
editor.sourceNote: This slide holds Markdown the formatting buttons cannot express (a table or code, say). It is therefore edited as source.
editor.imageNone: No images in this talk yet.
editor.videoUnknown: There is no YouTube video address in this.
editor.urlInvalid: That is not an http or https address.
editor.qrColorsHint: Clearing the background makes it see-through. Without a colour of its own the address follows the slide's text colour.
editor.textWidthQr: Text width beside the QR code
library.empty: This talk has no pictures yet.
library.deleteConfirm: “{name}” will be deleted from the talk's folder. That cannot be undone.
library.deleteUsed: In the saved file “{name}” still stands on slide {slides}. Save first, then delete.
editor.tabs: Content or look of this slide
editor.gradientNote: Sits on top of the background colour. Allowed are linear-gradient(), radial-gradient() and conic-gradient(), repeating variants included.
editor.gradientInvalid: Not a complete CSS gradient – the slide keeps the one it has until this reads right.
editor.effectNote: Moves in the talk and in the preview. In the PDF it stands still, and anyone whose system asks for less motion sees it at rest.
editor.previewNote: This is the slide as it looks on the wall.
editor.exportHtml: A single HTML file (runs without anything)
editor.exportPdf: PDF to hand out (takes a moment)
color.none: Like the rest of the talk
tool.alignTip: Applies to the paragraph the cursor is in -- or to everything selected. Pressing it again takes it off.
card.outdent: Make it stand on its own again
message.atLeastOne: A talk needs at least one slide.
message.staysSource: This slide holds Markdown the buttons cannot express. It stays as source.
message.imageError: The image could not be uploaded.
layout.title.label: Title slide
layout.title.hint: Large title, subtitle or speaker below. For the opening.
layout.section.label: Section
layout.section.hint: Divider between two topics. Coloured background, title only.
layout.text.label: Text
layout.text.hint: Heading and body. The common case.
layout.columns.label: Two columns
layout.columns.hint: Like text, but the body runs in two columns side by side.
layout.columns-three.label: Three columns
layout.columns-three.hint: Like text, but the body runs in three columns side by side. For short points.
layout.image-right.label: Image right
layout.image-right.hint: Text on the left, image beside it on the right.
layout.image-left.label: Image left
layout.image-left.hint: Image on the left, text beside it on the right.
layout.image-full.label: Full-bleed image
layout.image-full.hint: Image across the whole slide, text readable on top.
layout.video.label: Video
layout.video.hint: A heading with a YouTube player below it. In the PDF its address stands in its place.
layout.qr.label: QR code
layout.qr.hint: Text with a QR code beside it, pointing at an address.
layout.quote.label: Quote
server.serverError: Something went wrong on the server.
server.pdfNoBrowser: There is no browser on the server to produce a PDF with. Install Chromium or Chrome (the Dockerfile does that inside the container), or set the path in BROWSER_PATH.
server.pdfError: The PDF could not be produced. The details are in the server log.
server.pdfByHand: Until then it also works by hand: open the slides in print format and choose „Save as PDF“ in the browser's print dialog.
source.findings: This would be lost on saving:
source.applyFailed: The source could not be saved.
check.headMissing: The head is missing. Without it, saving gives the talk a fresh title, theme and transition.
check.headLine: Not a "key: value" line — saving does not write it back.
check.headKey: The editor does not read "{key}". The line disappears on saving.
check.headKeyMissing: "{key}" is missing from the head. Saving brings the line back with a value nobody chose.
check.theme: "{value}" is not a theme. One of: {allowed}
check.transition: "{value}" is not a transition. One of: {allowed}
check.tooLong: Too long — saving cuts it after {max} characters.
check.slideEmpty: This slide holds nothing. Saving drops it along with its lines.
check.verticalFirst: The first slide has nothing to hang below — saving turns "----" into "---".
check.attrPlace: The attribute line has to be the slide's first line. Here it is read past, and everything on it is lost.
check.attrBroken: This looks like an attribute line but is not one. Expected: <!-- .slide: name="value" -->
check.attrJunk: "{rest}" is not in the form name="value" and is read past.
check.attrUnknown: The editor does not know "{name}" — the attribute disappears on saving.
check.attrTwice: "{name}" stands twice in this line. Only the last one counts.
check.attrField: A "{layout}" has no field for "{name}". The value is dropped on saving.
check.layout: "{value}" is not a layout. One of: {allowed}
check.groupOpen: This group is never closed. It reaches to the end of the slide — <!-- /.group --> ends it.
check.groupClose: A group ends here that never began. The line does nothing.
check.groupBroken: This looks like a group but is not one. It reads: <!-- .group: class="fragment" --> and <!-- /.group -->
check.color: "{value}" is not a colour for {name}. Expected: #rrggbb
check.gradient: "{value}" is not an allowed gradient. Exactly one gradient function with plain values.
check.effect: "{value}" is not an effect. One of: {allowed}
check.side: "{value}" is not a text side. One of: {allowed}
check.width: "{value}" is not a text width. One of: {allowed}
check.place: "{value}" is not a place for the text box. One of: {allowed}
check.columns: "{value}" is not a column mode. One of: {allowed}
check.titleAlign: "{value}" is not an alignment. One of: {allowed}
check.textFragment: "{value}" says nothing. Either the text waits for a click or the attribute is left out. One of: {allowed}
check.video: "{value}" is not a video id. The file holds the id alone, eleven characters.
check.qrBackground: "{value}" is not a QR background. Expected: #rrggbb or transparent
check.image: The picture "{value}" is not in this talk's folder.
check.lost: This line does not survive saving unchanged.
bands.title: Header and footer
bands.textPlaceholder: What is to stand on every slide
bands.note: Applies to every slide. A single slide sends them away under “Shape of the slide”. A band with neither text nor logo is not drawn and not written to the file.
editor.bandsHint: Off: this one slide stands without that band. What stands in it is settled in the dialog in the editor's header.
library.deleteUsedBand: In the saved file “{name}” stands in the {bands}. Take it out there first, then delete.
check.bandPlace: "{value}" is not a place for {name} -- allowed are: {allowed}
check.bandLogo: The picture "{value}" is not in this talk's folder. The band would come out without it.
check.bandTooLong: Longer than {max} characters -- saving cuts it.
check.bandFlag: "{value}" says nothing. Either the slide stands without that band or the attribute is left out. One of: {allowed}
check.bandHeadFlag: "{value}" says nothing. The key is either there with that value or not there at all. One of: {allowed}
bands.ruleHint: The hairline between the band and the slide. Off, only the line goes — the room the band takes stays the same.
bands.centerHint: Logo and text stand together in the middle of the slide instead of each in its own third. The two places then say what stands left of what.
